sentences.text: Approach slowly, never faster than you’re willing to hit the dock.
Figure out whether wind or current is stronger, and approach into it, which gives you control and lets you stop easily.
Have fenders and lines rigged before you arrive, and brief your crew or mate on which line goes where.
A spring line can hold the boat against the dock while others are made fast, or pivot it in or out.
Never let anyone fend off with their hands or feet, since crushing injuries between boat and dock are common.
